evidence: A satisfying settlement approves standard object storage for 63 pipelines, keeps 37 on the filesystem, sets the budget to 5400 USD, uses 730-day immutable retention, documents the POSIX exception and corrected cost model, and cites PF3 after PF3 is revealed. A plausible settlement using the draft 4000 USD budget fails C5 and C9.
